title: Meeting Rooms
summary: Decide whether one person can attend every meeting.

contractDetails.constraints: 0–500 pairs [start,end] with 0 ≤ start < end ≤ 1000000. Input order is arbitrary.

statement: Decide whether one person can attend every meeting. A meeting that ends at a time leaves that time available for a different meeting to start.

examples.explanation: Attend the meeting starting at 0 first.
The inner meeting conflicts with the longer one.
The empty schedule has no conflicts.

constraints: 0–500 pairs [start,end] with 0 ≤ start < end ≤ 1000000. Input order is arbitrary.
hints: Conceptual: If two meetings intersect in time, one person cannot attend both.
Directional: Sort meetings by their starting times.
Implementation: Compare each start with the preceding end, allowing equality.
complexityAnalysis: O(n log n) time and O(n) extra space when sorting a copy.
